description: Resolves which Mobiscroll Connect SDK (language and version) a project depends on, from the contents of its dependency manifest, and returns the Connect API and SDK versions this server documents. This server runs remotely and has no access to the local filesystem, so the manifest contents are passed in as manifestContent.

manifestContent.description: Raw content of the project dependency manifest: package.json, pyproject.toml, composer.json, *.csproj, pom.xml, go.mod, or Gemfile. Read the file from the workspace and pass its content here.

name: resolveConnectEnvironment
title: Resolve Mobiscroll Connect Environment
